ORDER BY n.triggered_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification n WHERE AND AND
SELECT n.category AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS `count`, NULL AS label FROM notification n WHERE AND AND GROUP BY n.category ORDER BY n.category
SELECT n.severity AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS `count`, NULL AS label FROM notification n WHERE AND AND GROUP BY n.severity ORDER BY n.severity

SELECT CAST(n.workspace_id AS CHAR) AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS `count`, w.name AS label FROM notification n JOIN workspace w ON w.id = n.workspace_id JOIN workspace_member active_wm ON active_wm.workspace_id = n.workspace_id AND active_wm.user_id = #{recipientId} AND active_wm.status = 'active' WHERE AND AND GROUP BY n.workspace_id, w.name ORDER BY n.workspace_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN n.dismissed_at IS NULL AND n.resolved_at IS NULL AND n.read_at IS NULL AND (n.snoozed_until IS NULL OR n.snoozed_until <= #{asOf}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS unread, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN n.dismissed_at IS NULL AND n.resolved_at IS NULL AND n.snoozed_until > #{asOf} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS snoozed, COALESCE(( SELECT state_version FROM notification_recipient_state WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} ), 0) AS state_version FROM notification n WHERE AND AND
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(n.snoozed_until), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') FROM notification n WHERE AND AND AND n.dismissed_at IS NULL AND n.resolved_at IS NULL AND n.snoozed_until > #{asOf}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO notification_recipient_state (recipient_id, state_version) VALUES
(#{recipientId}, 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state_version = notification_recipient_state.state_version + 1

mapper.update: UPDATE notification n SET read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND AND AND n.id = #{id} AND n.read_at IS NULL
UPDATE notification n SET read_at = NULL WHERE AND AND AND n.id = #{id} AND n.read_at IS NOT NULL
UPDATE notification n SET dismissed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND AND AND n.id = #{id} AND n.dismissed_at IS NULL AND n.resolved_at IS NULL

UPDATE notification n SET dismissed_at = NULL, resolved_at = NULL, read_at = NULL, snoozed_until = NULL, snooze_timezone = NULL WHERE AND AND AND n.id = #{id} AND (n.dismissed_at IS NOT NULL OR n.resolved_at IS NOT NULL)
UPDATE notification n SET snoozed_until = #{snoozedUntil}, snooze_timezone = #{snoozeTimezone} WHERE AND AND AND n.id = #{id} AND n.dismissed_at IS NULL AND n.resolved_at IS NULL
UPDATE notification n SET snoozed_until = NULL, snooze_timezone = NULL WHERE AND AND AND n.id = #{id} AND n.snoozed_until IS NOT NULL

UPDATE notification n SET read_at = #{readAt} WHERE AND AND AND n.id <= #{cutoffId} AND dismissed_at IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL AND read_at IS NULL AND (snoozed_until IS NULL OR snoozed_until <= #{readAt})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( workspace_id, recipient_id, type, category, severity, template_version, title, body, actor_id, actor_label, source_type, source_id, source_label, context_type, context_id, context_label, action_url, data, dedupe_key, triggered_at ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{recipientId}, #{type}, #{category}, #{severity}, #{templateVersion}, #{title}, #{body}, (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id = #{actorId} FOR SHARE), #{actorLabel}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceLabel}, #{contextType}, #{contextId}, #{contextLabel}, #{actionUrl}, #{data}, #{dedupeKey}, #{triggeredAt} ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE read_at = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, NULL, notification.read_at ), dismissed_at = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, NULL, notification.dismissed_at ), triggered_at = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, incoming.triggered_at, notification.triggered_at ), snoozed_until = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, NULL, notification.snoozed_until ), snooze_timezone = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, NULL, notification.snooze_timezone ), resolved_at = IF( notification.severity <> incoming.severity OR notification.resolved_at IS NOT NULL, NULL, notification.resolved_at ), type = incoming.type, category = incoming.category, template_version = incoming.template_version, title = incoming.title, body = incoming.body, actor_id = incoming.actor_id, actor_label = incoming.actor_label, source_type = incoming.source_type, source_id = incoming.source_id, source_label = incoming.source_label, context_type = incoming.context_type, context_id = incoming.context_id, context_label = incoming.context_label, action_url = incoming.action_url, data = incoming.data, severity = incoming.severity
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notification n WHERE AND n.type IN () ORDER BY n.id
SELECT FROM notification n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.type IN () ORDER BY n.recipient_id, n.id

SELECT t.workspace_id, t.id AS task_id, t.description AS task_label, t.due_date, t.assigned_to_id AS recipient_id, u.timezone AS recipient_timezone, d.id AS deal_id, d.name AS deal_label, p.id AS person_id, p.name AS person_label FROM task t JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = t.assigned_to_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = t.assigned_to_id LEFT JOIN deal d ON d.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND d.id = t.deal_id LEFT JOIN person p ON p.id = t.person_id AND WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.completed = FALSE AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.id

SELECT DISTINCT d.workspace_id, d.id AS deal_id, d.name AS deal_label, d.expected_close_date, recipients.recipient_id, u.timezone AS recipient_timezone FROM deal d JOIN ( SELECT owned.workspace_id, owned.id AS deal_id, owned.owner_id AS recipient_id FROM deal owned WHERE owned.owner_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT collaborated.workspace_id, collaborated.id AS deal_id, dc.user_id AS recipient_id FROM deal collaborated JOIN deal_collaborator dc ON dc.workspace_id = collaborated.workspace_id AND dc.deal_id = collaborated.id WHERE collaborated.owner_id IS NOT NULL ) recipients ON recipients.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND recipients.deal_id = d.id JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = recipients.recipient_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = recipients.recipient_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND d.closed_at IS NULL AND d.expected_close_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.id, recipients.recipient_id

SELECT DISTINCT d.workspace_id, d.id AS deal_id, d.name AS deal_label, d.expected_close_date, d.value AS deal_value, s.position AS stage_position, pm.max_position AS pipeline_max_position, dp.role AS person_role, p.id AS person_id, p.name AS person_label, recipients.recipient_id FROM deal d JOIN deal_person dp ON dp.deal_id = d.id JOIN person p ON p.id = dp.person_id AND LEFT JOIN stage s ON s.id = d.stage_id AND s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pipeline_id, MAX(position) AS max_position FROM stage WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND is_success = FALSE AND is_failure = FALSE GROUP BY pipeline_id ) pm ON pm.pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id JOIN ( SELECT owned.workspace_id, owned.id AS deal_id, owned.owner_id AS recipient_id FROM deal owned WHERE owned.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND owned.owner_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT collaborated.workspace_id, collaborated.id AS deal_id, dc.user_id AS recipient_id FROM deal collaborated JOIN deal_collaborator dc ON dc.workspace_id = collaborated.workspace_id AND dc.deal_id = collaborated.id WHERE collaborated.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND collaborated.owner_id IS NOT NULL ) recipients ON recipients.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND recipients.deal_id = d.id JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = recipients.recipient_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND d.closed_at IS NULL AND p.risk_excluded = FALSE AND p.suspended_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.id, p.id, recipients.recipient_id
SELECT value FROM deal WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND owner_id IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NULL

SELECT d.id AS deal_id, d.name AS deal_label, recipients.recipient_id FROM deal d JOIN ( SELECT owned.workspace_id, owned.id AS deal_id, owned.owner_id AS recipient_id FROM deal owned WHERE owned.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND owned.owner_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT collaborated.workspace_id, collaborated.id AS deal_id, dc.user_id AS recipient_id FROM deal collaborated JOIN deal_collaborator dc ON dc.workspace_id = collaborated.workspace_id AND dc.deal_id = collaborated.id WHERE collaborated.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND collaborated.owner_id IS NOT NULL ) recipients ON recipients.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND recipients.deal_id = d.id JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = recipients.recipient_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND d.closed_at IS NULL AND d.risk_excluded = FALSE ORDER BY d.id, recipients.recipient_id
SELECT id FROM workspace ORDER BY id
SELECT user_id FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY user_id
SELECT DISTINCT recipient_id FROM notification WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND type IN () AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY recipient_id
SELECT DISTINCT recipient_id FROM notification WHERE actor_id = #{userId} ORDER BY recipient_id
SELECT recipient_id FROM notification WHERE actor_id = #{userId} ORDER BY recipient_id, id FOR UPDATE
